name: Tambov Summer 2017
information: Registration will be closed at midnight on July, 26. There is a limit of 100 competitors for this competition. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * 300 RUB (or 200 RUB using on-line prepayment); Please contact to main organizer for prepayment info. If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please contact us to resolve the issue. Visit the competition website for more details.
